title: Shared workload identity must not become individual-agent identity or authority
invariant: When several logical agents present one workload credential, only the shared principal is authenticated. Individual-agent attribution, revocation, policy identity, delegation and effect authority require separate current evidence bound to that exact principal and action.

cases.setup: Create an issuer-signed synthetic machine credential for the shared workload principal and answer one exact local holder challenge with its bound operational key.
cases.expected: The existing verifier authenticates only the shared principal with no authority effect; relabelling it as a logical agent or answering with that agent's holder key fails closed.

cases.setup: After authenticating the shared workload holder presentation, bind a separate current synthetic grant to that shared principal, then relabel the request as one logical agent.
cases.expected: The request is denied on the grant principal binding; neither the shared identity evidence nor the shared grant proves the logical agent identity.

cases.setup: Use the same current synthetic grant with the exact shared workload principal retained on the request and receipt.
cases.expected: The bounded synthetic request can complete only as the shared principal; no individual-agent attribution or external effect is claimed.

cases.setup: Create a distinct issuer-signed synthetic credential and holder presentation for the logical agent, then bind a separate current synthetic grant to that exact principal.
cases.expected: The bounded synthetic request can complete with distinct attribution only after both identity and grant controls succeed independently; no external effect is performed.

non_claims: This fixture does not implement or certify WIMSE.
This fixture creates only ephemeral local synthetic issuer keys, credentials and holder presentations; it adds no production issuer, credential, network path or authentication service.
Distinct identity does not grant action, delegation, effect, merge, deployment or production authority.
A completed synthetic reference-adapter request performs no external effect and proves no production interoperability.
